subject: Reading holds a physical message card below the beak
visualAssertions: At a 390-pixel viewport, the unlabeled Reading pose and action visibly differ from Idle.
The card sits below the beak without hiding the face; a supporting wing visibly reaches it, so it does not read as a floating badge.
The other wing traces or advances a line, coupled to readable line movement; this is distinct from Working's alternating control-pad key presses.
Downward attention and occasional glance up preserve the approved griffin likeness, with fur attached to the moving wings.
behaviorAssertions: Reading has a visible card and a non-neutral supporting/reading wing pose after transition.
Reading contains a changing trace or line-advance action, separate from Working's tap action.
Natural blinking continues during Reading without using the Blink button.
Pause freezes pose, props, trace/line progress and state age; resume continues.
Reduced motion uses a distinct, static held-card pose.
Leaving Reading clears the card and reading gesture after transition.
Idle, Listening, Working and Ready retain their previous behavior.
limits: 390-pixel and desktop captures are desktop Edge emulation, not real-phone performance.
Visual contact and face visibility require actual screenshot/video inspection, not debug values alone.
